propositions: The completion verifier pins the ticket store snapshot with fetch=False, causing materialize_tickets to read a stale local refs/heads/tickets mirror instead of the live tracker HEAD, resulting in the verifier seeing outdated ticket state (e.g. status and comments) that contradicts the actual store.

The gate's two halves read different stores: the fenced context given to the LLM comes from the live store, while the model's show_ticket call reads the pinned stale snapshot, causing the model to prefer false stale evidence over correct current context.

A non-PASS verdict with no findings is coerced to FAIL and synthesized with a fabricated placeholder criterion (unspecified) instead of reporting a verifier fault or indeterminacy, leaving operators with no actionable remediation path.

Two separate tickets (wailsome-unsure-asianlion, fixable-angular-caribou) failed close verification due to the stale snapshot showing absent or incomplete ticket data, with the second ticket exhibiting symptoms of evidence search starvation when evidence actually existed in the live store.
